---
name: 功能建议 / Feature request
about: 描述希望完成的设备开发任务 / Describe a device development task
---

## 使用场景 / Use case

涉及哪种主控、目标和工作区？当前如何完成这项工作？

Which host, target and workspace are involved? How do you do this today?

## 期望行为 / Desired behavior

请给出一个具体操作，以及能判断它已成功的结果。

Give one concrete action and the outcome that would tell you it worked.
